lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a semi-ordered grid posterior to the gill slits, with higher density visible in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of white spots, creating distinct grid-like nodes across the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-luminance pixels on the upper edge to deep shadow on the lower edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two circular pale patches, possibly abrasions or lesions, are visible on the dorsal-lateral surface of the head, anterior to the branchial region.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) attached ventrally near the gill slits and trailing from the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
